messages:
Morgan: Quick sync — prelaunch check for webinar landing + inbound funnel. Need keyword mapping, schema snippets, and redirect plan before Monday. Linking sheet: https://tiny.redwood/kw-funnel (internal)
Jules: can we prioritize high-intent keywords for registration and post-webinar blog? thinking 'streaming llm inference', 'llm inference platform', 'low-latency llm serving' etc.
Ana: I'll drop a canonical + schema checklist. Also suggest adding FAQ schema on landing. Will post snippets in a sec.
Devon: dev note: redirects need 301s from old campaign pages. any existing paths to preserve?
Priya: @Morgan FYI we have /webinar/2025-03-live and legacy /events/llm-inference which still indexed. we should redirect /events/* -> /webinar/2025-03-live where appropriate.
Ana: snippet to paste into template:
```
<script type=\"application/ld+json\">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"WebPage","mainEntity":{"@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference: Production Inference Webinar","startDate":"2025-03-18T16:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar/2025-03-live"}}</script>
```
Also FAQ block example:
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"What does Redwood Inference do?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Provides a unified runtime for production-grade LLM inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments."}}]}
```
Devon: can implement the redirects like:
```
rewrite ^/events/llm-inference$ /webinar/2025-03-live permanent;
rewrite ^/old-campaign/(.*)$ /webinar/2025-03-live?src=old-campaign permanent;
```
but need SEO QA and a staging run so we don't lose UTM landing signals.
Jules: will update the keyword spreadsheet and mark the canonical target column + target meta title/meta description for the landing. also adding a short benchmark narrative paragraph for the post-webinar blog.
Ana: also recommend internal links from /docs/inference-ops and /blog/benchmarks to the webinar landing for PR. anchor text suggestions: \"low-latency inference\", \"production LLM serving\", \"inference cost optimizations\".
Morgan: perf checklist — ensure page loads <2s (LCP), schema validated in Rich Results test, canonical tag present, robots noindex only if staging, and redirects staged in staging env. I'll open a short runbook and assign owners in the sheet.
seo-bot: Google Search Console crawl requested for /webinar/2025-03-live :white_check_mark:
Priya: copy edits coming tonight. tagging @Devon for staging rollout tomorrow AM :rocket:
Morgan: thanks all — I'll summarize actions and owners in the sheet and ping again after staging deploy. :thumbsup:
